scope: Coverage of nine known training-family full-body reference clips; local engineering target, not unseen-motion or release qualification
requirement: All 27 cells must be present exactly once, complete their reference remainder and pass every per-trial metric. Do not exclude falls or score only surviving trials.
comparison_status: Quality target fixed after feasibility baselines and before learned reference-tracking development. A separate pre-training run charter must freeze the shared initialization, complete goal/observation/action/reward semantics, noise, update/collection budgets, selection and cost accounting before any world-model/PPO comparison.
cost_accounting: Report shared reference/teacher/parent/initialization development separately from incremental learner collection, world-model/critic/actor updates, evaluation and serialization. If the shared initialization already passes, both incremental cost-to-this-target values are zero; do not infer a learning speedup.
